name: settleview_service_silent

query_condition.sql: SELECT coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN service_name = 'settleview-app' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS app, coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN service_name = 'settleview-rec-pm-quotes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS quotes, coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN service_name = 'settleview-rec-pm-settle' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS settle FROM "process_memory_usage" HAVING coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN service_name = 'settleview-app' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) = 0 OR coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN service_name = 'settleview-rec-pm-quotes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) = 0 OR coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN service_name = 'settleview-rec-pm-settle' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) = 0

description: A service stopped reporting (down, or its telemetry is).

context_attributes.slo: Every service reports at least every 5 min.
